digest.component_or_area: tickets branch push logging and classification (push.py, push_classify.py, push_recovery.py, push_state.py)
propositions: Expected best-effort push failures due to concurrent-writer contention (lost non-fast-forward race, mid-retry transport faults, routine unpushed-backlog suffix) are logged at WARNING/INFO and priming LLM agent sessions to waste tokens investigating non-issues.

Terminal contention losses and mid-retry transient notices must be demoted from INFO/WARNING to DEBUG, with wording stating expected-and-self-healing outcome and 'no action needed', while policy declines and proven-growing backlogs remain WARNING.
Backlog messages must name the tickets branch explicitly (no bare ..HEAD) and state the self-healing contract: commits are local and publish on the next successful push.
A proven-growing backlog (compared against the previous push-pending marker's unpushed count) escalates to WARNING; a static or shared count under ordinary concurrent load is not an outage signal.
